description: This donut chart illustrates the distribution of various categories of a "Stimulus Type," as indicated by the bolded, slightly angled text located in the center hole of the graphic. The chart is divided into ten distinct slices, with category labels and exact percentages positioned outside the ring next to their corresponding segments, eliminating the need for a separate legend. Moving clockwise from the top right, the largest segment is colored dark red and labeled "Draft/Other (26.4%)". This is followed by a dark brown slice for "Event Posting (6.6%)", a mauve slice for "Organizational Report (7.7%)", a light purple slice for "Organizational Website (4.9%)", and a dark blue slice for "Interview (8.8%)". Continuing clockwise, there is a light blue slice with a partially obscured label ending in "agency" showing a percentage of approximately 4.4%, a dark green slice for "External News Article (18.1%)", a light green slice for "Email (2.7%)", a golden-yellow slice for "Press Release (18.7%)", and a very thin orange slice for "Social Media Post (1.1%)". The segments are not arranged in a strict ascending or descending order based on their proportional size, and none of the individual slices are visually exploded or offset from the main ring.
